{{Wired embedded system |brand=Radxa |model=NX5 |revision=IO Board Kit (v1.4) |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |price=100 |est_release_date=11/2023 |type=single-board computer |pwr_v=5 |pwr_amp=4 |pwr_conn=barrel |pwr_barrel_outer=5.5 |pwr_barrel_inner=2.1 |pwr_barrel_len=9.5 |cpu1_brand=Rockchip |cpu1_model=RK3588S |cpu1_cspeed=1.8-2.4 GHz |cpu1_cores=8 |fla1=32 GiB |fla1_brand=Samsung |fla1_model=KLMBG2JETD-B041 |ram1=4 GiB |ram1_brand=Micron |ram1_model= |ram1_num=2 |expansion_if_types=Mini PCIe (NGFF M.2), USB 3.0, USB 2.0 |expansion_minipcie_num=1 |expansion_usb_num=5 |serial=yes,, via GPIO header,, 3.3V TTL,, (1500000 8N1) |eth_cpu=true |eth_chip2_brand=Realtek |eth_chip2_model=RTL8211F |lan_speed=1GbE |lan_ports=1 |flags=Micro SD card slot, HDMI, DisplayPort, MIPI CSI, fan, heatsink |stock_boot=U-Boot;rknext-2017.09; |stock_os=Linux;5.10.110-26-rockchip;Debian 11; |tp_firmware=Android 12, BredOS |default_ip=acquired via DHCP |default_user=radxa |default_pass=radxa }} {{TagLine|Radxa NX5 IO Board Kit}} :[https://radxa.com/products/io-board/nx5-io-board/ Product page]
Consists of the [[Radxa NX5]] and a NX5 IO Board.
"Radxa NX5 V1.1", [[Radxa]] logo and "20231020" :are silkscreened on SoM top. [[Radxa]] logo, "MODEL: NX5 IO Board" and "V1.4 2023.10.20" :are silkscreened on the Carrier Board bottom.
{{See also|Radxa|Radxa A8|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3588 @2.4GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) :+ @1.8GHz Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G610'' MP4 (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.2); NPU Support 6T :VPU (with 8K @60fps VP9 and 8K @30fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) flash, TF card (max.256GB)/MMC card *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4x) SDRAM ([[Micron]]) *Network: 1x GbE port *USB: 4x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 (Micro-B) (OTG) ports *PCI: 1x M.2 (E-key) PCIe 2.1 slot *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V/4A via barrel
